question: List all the clients' IDs whose junior credit cards were issued after 1996.
evidence: After 1996 means date > = '1997-01-01
sql: SELECT T2.client_id, PX.gender FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id LEFT JOIN "client" AS PX ON PX.client_id = T2.client_id WHERE T1.type = 'junior' AND T1.issued >= '1997-01-01'
gold_sql: SELECT T2.client_id FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id WHERE T1.type = 'junior' AND T1.issued >= '1997-01-01'
